title: Capture health and diagnostics feature doc screenshots
description:
Problem: `features/health-and-diagnostics` now includes placeholder IDs but no final screenshots.

Desired outcome: capture and embed images for FEAT-HEALTH placeholders so observability docs are visually actionable.

Scope:
- In scope: FEAT-HEALTH-01..04 capture, redaction, asset storage in `Data/Pages/assets`, markdown image insertion.
- Out of scope: broader admin/auth screenshots and chat workflows.

Acceptance criteria:
- All FEAT-HEALTH placeholders are fulfilled with image assets and embeds.
- Sensitive runtime fields in diagnostics captures are redacted.
- Page renders correctly in `/pages` with no broken image links.

Validation:
- Open `features/health-and-diagnostics` in `/pages` and verify all images load and match step intent.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to track FEAT-HEALTH screenshot capture and insertion.
